people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.
translations.bsb: And on the day you cross the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving you, set up large stones and coat them with plaster.
translations.kjv: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over Jordan unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaister them with plaister:
translations.asv: And it shall be on the day when ye shall pass over the Jordan unto the land which Jehovah thy God giveth thee, that thou shalt set thee up great stones, and plaster them with plaster:
